 The Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi south Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 5 for the offences punishable U/s.498A,323, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
 3  C.C.No.23484/2024  2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. KUSUMA Y.S..
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 29-10- 2020.
At the time of marriage, the accused No.1 to 5 have demanded and taken gold ornaments weighing 100 gms, one wrist watch and cash of Rs.75,000/- as dowry from the complainant and her family.

Further, the accused No.1 to 5 after the marriage with common intention have subjected CW 1 to mental and physical cruelty by quarreling with her for petty matters, not providing food to her and not letting her to go to work where she was working Smt Kusuma Ys vs Vivek Bs on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35504696/
2 before the marriage, abused her in filthy language, assaulted her physically due to which she fell ill and used Rs.20,000/- which she got as settlement from her employer and when the accused came to know about CW-1 spending the amount, all the accused have quarreled with her, abused her in filthy language, assaulted her with hands, harassed her to get Rs.Five lakhs as additional dowry,
by suspecting her chastity the accused have not let her to speak to any one including her family members.
On 08-03-2021 the accused have harassed her to get Rs.Five lakhs and threatened her if she does not get amount, they well get the accused No.1 remarriage to someone else and accused will kill her.

Lastly, on 10-10-2023 at  4  C.C.No.23484/2024 about 6.30 p.m. the accused No.1 to 5 came near the house of CW- 2 and threatened to kill CW-1, if she does not give Rs.Five lakhs and if she fails to withdraw the petition filed under Domestic Violence Act and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty in demand of more dowry.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.294/2023 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.

3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I.
Basavanagudi Women South P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused No.1 to 5 for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused No.1 to 5 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  the offences punishable U/s.498A,323, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.?
 2) what order?

 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.

sentences.text: 9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 to Ex.P3 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
Ex . P.3
is the further statement.
10 . CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Kusuma.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 29-10-2020 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused, assaulted her and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2  7  C.C.No.23484/2024 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.

sentences.text: On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
and in the absence of evidence of material witness, the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 8  C.C.No.23484/2024  ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 to 5 acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A,323, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 to 5 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.

(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on the computer and print out taken by her is verified,
corrected & then pronounced by me in the Open Court dated this the 02-12 -2025).
